user.title: PurpleAir sensor
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of a PurpleAir sensor on your network.

data_description.host: The integration polls the sensor's local /json endpoint over HTTP.

name.title: Name and migration
name.description: This sensor reports its placement as {place}.

data.name: Name
data.legacy_prefix: Existing entity ID to take over (optional)

data_description.name: Device name; entity names are added to it.
data_description.legacy_prefix: If this sensor is already set up with REST or template sensors, enter the AQI entity ID (for example sensor.outdoor_air). The next step matches the other sensors to it so they keep their entity IDs and history.

adopt.title: Take over existing entities
adopt.description:
Each entity ID listed here will be moved to this integration and keep its history, settings, area and labels. Clear a field to create a new entity instead.

Before setup can finish, remove the REST sensors, template helpers or other sources that currently provide these entities. Setup waits and retries until they are gone.

error.invalid_response: The host did not return PurpleAir JSON.
error.invalid_entity_id: Enter a sensor entity ID, such as sensor.outdoor_air.
error.duplicate_entity_id: The same entity ID is used twice.

abort.wrong_device: That host is a different PurpleAir sensor.

data_description.scan_interval: The sensor averages its readings over 2 minutes, so polling faster than 60 seconds rarely adds information.
